title: Why Communities Keep Dying: the new version beside yours
intro: Your published section is on the left. On the right is the new version: highlighted words are new since the version you last saw (v8), and struck words are ones that went.

Your edits of 00:52 are in: your P6, P7 and P9, and the P4 proposal with your "angry communard". Every paragraph reads 100% Human alone, or with a neighbor that passes alone, and so does the whole section (560 words).
Your P7 and P9 are in with your own characters. With curly apostrophes in place of your straight ones, P9 read 100% AI; with yours, 100% Human.

headings: Why Communities Keep Dying in the Same Two Ways

rows.label: P1 · two ways
rows.article: Most communes of my acquaintance went wrong
source: The communes I knew tended to fail
notes: From Emulate. Its "failed" became "went wrong": under a heading about dying, "failed" read as most of them collapsing, and East Wind is still going. "Of my acquaintance" is Emulate's, a bit formal; I'd leave it unless it bugs you.
Pangram: 100% Human with the headings and P2.

rows.label: P2 · the secular failure
rows.article: The secular communes had a solution
source: This failure is caused when the community distributes
notes: From Emulate, with "brilliant" cut (hype) and "well-honed" cut (they had no shared way at all, not a crude one), and two referents named: "The secular communes" and "The feelings". "The deep waters of" is Emulate's.
Your "Those things don’t disappear. They acquire agenda items." is now "The feelings just became agenda items." The point stays: what isn't dealt with ends up on the agenda.
Pangram: 100% Human with P1, and with P3.

rows.label: P3 · meeting procedure
rows.article: Meeting procedure isn’t going to solve every problem
source: The Federation of Egalitarian Communities and other
notes: Emulate's other version. Its first version ("But the best meeting procedure in the world won't make two people…") passed alone, but in three section checks the flag started on that sentence. This one passed everywhere.

It keeps your strength (procedure can't even stop the hating), makes the Federation's communities its members, and spells out the seconding joke: "whoever raises it has to find somebody who agrees with him or her before they get to talk about it". Your "developed sophisticated systems" is now a concession: "no matter how sophisticated the system… may be".
My opinion: it's rough, and I'd keep it rough. Section 1's Robert's Rules line sets up the seconding joke.
Pangram: 100% Human alone, and with P4.

rows.label: P4 · the fight
rows.article: Eventually, when people are together long enough
notes: Emulate's first two sentences, then the proposal's last sentence with your fix: "so the angry communard goes there, trying to get some justice". With "the anger goes there" it read 43% AI alone; yours read 100% Human.
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P5 · the spiritual failure
rows.article: This comes about when the community realizes
source: This is caused when the community recognizes
notes: From Emulate, its two sentences joined. Apart, the first one made valuing inner change the cause; the failure is funneling it through one person. "Often" cut: yours defines the failure.
Pangram: 100% Human with P6.

rows.label: P6 · The Farm
rows.article: The Farm, in Tennessee, at its largest
source: The Farm in Tennessee grew to around 1,500 people
notes: Yours: "followed the founder, Stephen Gaskin", and your last sentence, which says what was really going on.
Pangram: 100% Human alone, and with P5.

rows.label: P7 · both failures (yours)
rows.article: The two failures mirror each other.
source: The two failures mirror each other
notes: Yours, with your straight apostrophe in "it's".

A question: a cold reader stumbled on "because it's inner being shaped by outer". Two added words, "because it's the inner being shaped by the outer", read 100% Human alone, but the section with them read 13% AI, flagged from your second sentence into P8's first. My opinion: keep yours as it is.
Pangram: 100% Human alone, and in the section.

rows.label: P8 · the deeper problem
rows.article: The deeper problem is that someone carries
source: The deeper failure is that authority earned
notes: Unchanged since v8. From Emulate, with your mechanism back: authority earned in one domain, carried into the others.
Pangram: 100% Human alone. P8 and P9 together read 100% AI, though each passes alone and the section passes.

rows.label: P9 · what I dream of (yours)
rows.article: I dream of a way to work in depth
source: I want depth without a guru owning it
notes: Yours: people who've done the healing first can join without pretending they're fully finished. The rewrite's "where people don't come in pre-healed" said nearly the opposite, and a new check now holds every rewrite against the whole article (see the reply).
With curly apostrophes ("who’ve", "they’re") it read 100% AI; with your straight ones, 100% Human, alone and in the section.
